name: Transferable skill foundation
structure: Identify skill that persists across decks, then test it under changed constraints.
conditions: A skill transfers only if the new game's legal mechanics support it.
failure_case: Treating a previous game's rule as Riftbound law.
original_exercise_seed: A practice review isolates one repeated decision error across two different decks.
novelty: Linked conceptual refinement; independent novelty unverified.

name: Endpoint-conditioned point value
structure: Evaluate score against available next scoring sequences rather than numeric distance alone.
conditions: Verified scoring and actual position, alternate routes considered.
failure_case: A player has an alternate finishing effect that bypasses the assumed route.
original_exercise_seed: Compare two players at six whose feasible finishing sequences differ.
novelty: Linked conceptual refinement; independent novelty unverified.

name: Conditional score parity
structure: Group scores only when the same feasible route and timing apply.
conditions: Restricted double-score model, no intervening alternate score or hold.
failure_case: An odd point enables a hold or card-effect finish, invalidating equivalence.
original_exercise_seed: Test a single-point concession against both a hold-oriented and a two-score rival.
novelty: Linked conceptual refinement; independent novelty unverified.

name: Turn-order race
structure: Project earliest feasible finishing turn for each player under independent replies.
conditions: Do not assume future scoring is guaranteed.
failure_case: Opponent interrupts the expected next-turn score or has an earlier alternate route.
original_exercise_seed: The learner checks whether an apparent lead survives an opposing disruption.
novelty: Linked conceptual refinement; independent novelty unverified.

name: Point acquisition opportunity cost
structure: Compare immediate score, exposed material, later development and opponent payoff.
conditions: Board and resource states must be explicit.
failure_case: A sacrificed unit is necessary for an immediate legal win.
original_exercise_seed: Compare an exposed early threat against developing a protected scoring route.
novelty: Linked conceptual refinement; independent novelty unverified.

name: Conditional point concession
structure: Allow a low-impact opposing score only when preserving resources improves one's route.
conditions: Bound the opponent's entire feasible threat range.
failure_case: The conceded point changes an alternate finishing threshold.
original_exercise_seed: A practice partner challenges the assumption that one more point is safe.
novelty: Linked conceptual refinement; independent novelty unverified.

name: Earliest credible lethal threshold
structure: Identify legal scoring sequences and prerequisites; distinguish possible from guaranteed.
conditions: Exact cards, resources, targets, timing and current legality.
failure_case: Treating a deck label or historical combo as proof of lethal.
original_exercise_seed: Write two possible finish routes and mark every missing prerequisite.
novelty: Linked conceptual refinement; independent novelty unverified.

name: Pressure as forced allocation
structure: A credible scoring threat changes which resources a rival must spend now.
conditions: Threat actually attainable and opponent has independent choices.
failure_case: The opponent can safely ignore the threat or win first.
original_exercise_seed: A control player must choose between developing an engine and contesting a credible score.
novelty: Linked conceptual refinement; independent novelty unverified.

name: Emergency expenditure
structure: Use a valuable reserved piece defensively only when the avoided threat justifies its loss.
conditions: Compare all legal cheaper answers and counterplay.
failure_case: Spending a finisher when a less costly answer exists.
original_exercise_seed: The learner records why an emergency defensive use was necessary.
novelty: Linked conceptual refinement; independent novelty unverified.

name: Match-level concession threshold
structure: Compare remaining live routes with remaining time and match-level alternatives.
conditions: Concession permitted; consider outs, clock and match score.
failure_case: Conceding merely because recovery is unlikely, or colluding over outcomes.
original_exercise_seed: A player assesses realistic outs before deciding whether to continue a practice game.
novelty: Linked conceptual refinement; independent novelty unverified.

name: Inter-round recovery budget
structure: Record gameplay, setup and break time as competing demands on sustained performance.
conditions: Actual event schedule and individual needs; no universal recovery effect.
failure_case: Treating arbitrary minutes as tournament policy.
original_exercise_seed: A player plans food and rest around observed round duration without assuming a guaranteed break.
novelty: Linked conceptual refinement; independent novelty unverified.

name: Clock-aware fair pacing
structure: Allocate time by decision complexity while keeping play reasonably prompt.
conditions: Event rules, no deliberate delay or forced fixed response time.
failure_case: Using clock management to justify slow play.
original_exercise_seed: A practice log identifies routine decisions that can become more efficient.
novelty: Linked conceptual refinement; independent novelty unverified.

name: Contingent forward plan
structure: Prepare a likely next sequence and update when draws or opposition change it.
conditions: Plan includes alternative states and legal response windows.
failure_case: Blindly following a preplanned sequence after a changed board.
original_exercise_seed: Rehearse two continuations from the same opening, then introduce an unexpected public event.
novelty: Linked conceptual refinement; independent novelty unverified.

name: Procedural fluency practice
structure: Rehearse setup, mulligans and legal routine movements outside a match.
conditions: Solo practice does not model adversarial response.
failure_case: Treating goldfish success as matchup win evidence.
original_exercise_seed: Measure routine execution in repeated solo trials and separately test against opposition.
novelty: Linked conceptual refinement; independent novelty unverified.

name: Conditional decision shortcuts
structure: Compress repeated low-stakes decisions into a revisable conditional policy.
conditions: Policy validated for deck, date and opponent range.
failure_case: Applying a mulligan shortcut despite a changed matchup.
original_exercise_seed: A practice guide identifies a default opener and an explicit exception.
novelty: Linked conceptual refinement; independent novelty unverified.

name: Attention allocation
structure: Reserve deliberation for high-impact or uncertain choices.
conditions: Mental-resource metaphor is qualitative, not measured capacity.
failure_case: Assuming a fixed daily numerical cognitive budget.
original_exercise_seed: Review which routine decisions occupied attention needed for a later difficult choice.
novelty: Linked conceptual refinement; independent novelty unverified.

name: Draw provenance tracking
structure: Update hidden-hand hypotheses based on observable draws, plays and known reveals.
conditions: Distinguish certainty about known card identities from speculative inference.
failure_case: A player chooses a newly drawn card despite already having a viable opening.
original_exercise_seed: Track what changed in a previously revealed hand without guessing unrevealed cards.
novelty: Linked conceptual refinement; independent novelty unverified.

name: Hand information leakage
structure: Maintain legal card-handling habits that reduce accidental identity disclosure.
conditions: No marked cards, manipulation, concealment of mandatory public information or unreasonable delay.
failure_case: Assuming shuffling makes information from revealed cards disappear.
original_exercise_seed: Practice neutral card handling while preserving required public information.
novelty: Linked conceptual refinement; independent novelty unverified.

name: Zone-aware copy tracking
structure: Reconcile observed copies across zones, recursion, recycling and known movements.
conditions: Exact printing identity and applicable copy rule checked.
failure_case: Counting repeated appearances of one recycled copy as separate copies.
original_exercise_seed: A ledger distinguishes two distinct cards from two plays of one returned card.
novelty: Linked conceptual refinement; independent novelty unverified.

name: Resource-conditioned response range
structure: Filter plausible opposing responses by available resources, timing and card identity.
conditions: Track Energy, Power, domain and legal window separately.
failure_case: Assuming an available rune count uniquely identifies a response or importing old Yi math.
original_exercise_seed: Classify three hypothetical response packages by affordability and timing before choosing a line.
novelty: Linked conceptual refinement; independent novelty unverified.

name: Behavioral cue uncertainty
structure: Use visible reactions only as weak evidence alongside public facts.
conditions: Alternative motives and intentional signals remain possible.
failure_case: Inferring a specific hidden card or emotion with certainty.
original_exercise_seed: Two observers form different plausible explanations for a player's reaction.
novelty: Linked conceptual refinement; independent novelty unverified.

name: Consistent timely responses
structure: Reduce accidental information through reasonable, legal response habits.
conditions: Prompt play and required communication take precedence.
failure_case: Artificially delaying every pass or obscuring a mandatory action.
original_exercise_seed: Practice making routine passes promptly while avoiding unnecessary commentary.
novelty: Linked conceptual refinement; independent novelty unverified.

name: Represented response opportunity cost
structure: Compare the value of keeping credible interaction open with lost development.
conditions: Opponent may ignore represented interaction and bluff must be legal.
failure_case: Treating bluff as guaranteed or misrepresenting game facts.
original_exercise_seed: Compare development against leaving resources open when no actual response is held.
novelty: Linked conceptual refinement; independent novelty unverified.

name: Recursive uncertainty about tells
structure: Account for opponent awareness of one's inference without infinite speculation.
conditions: Anchor decisions in observable game state and feasible response ranges.
failure_case: Abandoning evidence for speculative layers of mind reading.
original_exercise_seed: A player chooses a robust line rather than committing to an unsupported behavioral read.
novelty: Linked conceptual refinement; independent novelty unverified.
